title: refactor(enter): simplify paid model filter
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Keeps the standard SDK `Switch` for the paid-model toggle.
- Moves the shorter `Hide paid` control directly below the sort selector.
- Keeps filtering local-only and preserves the canonical `isPaidOnly` predicate.

Follow-up to #13755.

gist.headline: Paid models, tidied up
gist.blurb: The model garden got a small pruning. The shorter Hide paid control now lives beside sorting, while the familiar toggle keeps doing its thing.
gist.summary: Simplified the paid-model filter in the Enter model browser by retaining the SDK Switch, moving the local-only “Hide paid” control below the sort selector, and preserving the canonical isPaidOnly predicate.
gist.impact: Users get a cleaner model-browsing layout and can still filter paid models locally without changing the underlying filtering behavior.
gist.visual_concept: Polli acts as a careful garden keeper at a cozy model-selection terminal, moving a small “Hide paid” seed label beneath a sort dial while a familiar toggle remains in place. Tiny code-plants and labeled model cards make the local filter feel like a neat bit of garden organization.
